description: One command turns a DGX Spark or ASUS Ascent GX10 into a private AI server: seven measured, pinned AI lanes (text up to 1M tokens, images, video with sound), run from a local cockpit on a laptop or a phone. Nothing leaves the box.
summary: Fastest measured Qwen3.8-27B config for DGX Spark (GB10): SGLang + NVFP4 + DFlash2, deterministic boots, 50 tok/s greedy median, 148 tok/s at 8 streams, 258 at 32. One command, everything pinned, lossless.
